name: TestThisConfigAction
description: Dry-run trigger and result surface for per-agent settings that executes a simulated run using unsaved draft values against a sample task, helping operators validate expected behavior before committing configuration changes.
usage: Render in the Agent Settings action area when a draft is present. Trigger a non-persistent dry-run against the selected sample task and display a structured result panel with outcome, expected execution trace, and risk flags.

props.name: validation
props.type: { isValid: boolean; errors: Array<{ field: string; message: string }> }

props.name: onRunDryTest
props.type: (payload: { agentId: string; sampleTaskId: string; draftConfig: AgentConfigDraft }) => Promise<DryRunResult>

accessibility.notes: Keyboard: button is in main tab order and remains reachable after result panel opens; Enter/Space triggers test; Escape closes result panel without clearing data. ARIA: test control uses aria-busy during execution; result container uses role='region' with aria-labelledby; summary updates announce via aria-live='polite'; blocked state includes explicit text and icon, not color-only signaling.

examples: <TestThisConfigAction agentId='orion' draftConfig={draft} sampleTaskId='triage-sample' isDirty validation={validation} onRunDryTest={runDry} lastResult={result} />
<TestThisConfigAction agentId='eli' draftConfig={saved} sampleTaskId='incident-template' isDirty={false} validation={{ isValid: true, errors: [] }} onRunDryTest={runDry} lastResult={null} />
dos: Disable test action only when validation fails; show specific blocker text beside the control.
Keep the primary test action touch target at least 44px on 375px viewports.
Label every dry-run output with 'Draft simulation' and timestamp to prevent confusion with persisted behavior.
Present expected execution steps as concise ordered items and include at least one confidence note.
donts: Do not mutate persisted agent settings from a test invocation.
Do not hide failed dry-run details behind an undiscoverable interaction.
Do not mix lime and teal accents on the same control state.
Do not clear the previous successful result until a new run starts.
